criteria.given: A cooperative coordinator continues a workstream with retained execution history and potentially missing or conflicting local state
criteria.when: Task state, evidence, recovery or writer admission is evaluated across runs
then: Before initialization, scheduling or writer admission, reconcile the current task contract, state, retained task evidence, durable checkpoint and relevant Git ancestry. Missing or contradictory history returns `recovery_required` with task IDs, exact evidence locations and next actions before any new base/writer is recorded.

criteria.given: A cooperative coordinator continues a workstream with retained execution history and potentially missing or conflicting local state
criteria.when: Task state, evidence, recovery or writer admission is evaluated across runs
then: Persist coordinator checkpoints outside the ignored worktree cache, under `refs/ask/inner-loop/<work-id>`, with immutable Git objects. Bind work/task identities, stable original initialization anchor, state generation, contract identities, source/base/candidate commits, and referenced result/run/review/integration artifacts and their digests. Store the actual required artifact bytes, not only paths to ignored files. Required source/base/candidate/runner and historical authority commits must remain Git-reachable through checkpoint parent edges, and artifact bytes through its tree; validate the full closure after fixture GC and self-contained bundle transfer.

criteria.given: A cooperative coordinator continues a workstream with retained execution history and potentially missing or conflicting local state
criteria.when: Task state, evidence, recovery or writer admission is evaluated across runs
then: Checkpoint writes use the existing process lock and compare-and-swap ref publication. Publish the immutable checkpoint before replacing the state cache. Death before publication leaves the previous checkpoint; death after publication permits replay of the published checkpoint. Detect cache/ref divergence and concurrent checkpoint writers. Coordinator alone owns checkpoint publication; nested verifier children never acquire the parent state lock or import checkpoint modules. Use transaction-internal finalization, idempotent report/ledger recovery, and the pre-hook runner handoff in checkpoint-design.md.

criteria.given: A cooperative coordinator continues a workstream with retained execution history and potentially missing or conflicting local state
criteria.when: Task state, evidence, recovery or writer admission is evaluated across runs
then: Preserve separate execution milestones (Red, Green, Refactor, review and integration) and their exact provenance. Resume from the first unmet valid milestone. Historical Green does not authorize integration; review is reusable only for its exact bound candidate/result/contract. Completion requires the normal coordinator verification and integration receipt.

criteria.given: A cooperative coordinator continues a workstream with retained execution history and potentially missing or conflicting local state
criteria.when: Task state, evidence, recovery or writer admission is evaluated across runs
then: Restore a missing/older cache from a validated checkpoint only when identities, artifacts, contract applicability and Git context agree. A newer/divergent cache, unsupported schema, incomplete checkpoint, unrelated checkout or changed contract requires explicit reconciliation. Do not infer Red, approval or integration from passing tests, source presence or commit messages.

criteria.given: A cooperative coordinator continues a workstream with retained execution history and potentially missing or conflicting local state
criteria.when: Task state, evidence, recovery or writer admission is evaluated across runs
then: Handle pre-checkpoint workstreams through a read-only reconciliation report and a reviewed explicit adoption record. Preserve original base/candidate and run history; attribute missing milestones honestly and renew only the stale evidence. An adoption cannot label an unverified task integrated. Test reclassification remains an independently reviewed contract change, never an automatic response to Green on resume. Before CR-1, apply the reviewed bootstrap described in bootstrap.md using existing CAS/admission APIs; add CR IDs and start only CR-1 at its own approved baseline while preserving every old task record and the product context.

criteria.given: A cooperative coordinator continues a workstream with retained execution history and potentially missing or conflicting local state
criteria.when: Task state, evidence, recovery or writer admission is evaluated across runs
then: `run`, `resume`, `cas-init`, `spawn-writer` and generic state mutation share recovery guards. Report recoverable stage and evidence through `status`/`reconcile`. Protect recorded execution history against silent lifecycle rollback; deliberate reopen/contract amendment preserves the prior attempt and starts an explicitly identified attempt. The initial scoped suspension is an explicit coordinator instruction until CR-1 enforces it. Every case binds exact immutable production/assertion/fixture files; runtime state and wildcard source bindings are excluded.

criteria.given: A cooperative coordinator continues a workstream with retained execution history and potentially missing or conflicting local state
criteria.when: Task state, evidence, recovery or writer admission is evaluated across runs
then: The `shorter-hashes` reconciliation covers Tasks 1–5, whose code/history predates the restarted queue, before product scheduling resumes. Checkpoint recovery preserves one writer, CAS, exact approvals, task-owned paths, accepted-tests authority and FF-only integration. No extra task or new product behavior is introduced implicitly. Combined graph ordering is 1 -> CR-1 -> CR-2 -> CR-3 -> CR-4 -> 2 -> ... -> 10, validated with original shared paths. No implementation or bootstrap is authorized by the seal.
